sample_unit: clinician-informed multiple-choice questions (plus 397 annotated one-minute clips; 280 patients in cohort analysis)
unlisted_practices: training-free multimodal agent harness that builds hierarchical minute-level action records from ICU video and clinical records for patient behavior understanding

screen.reason: The paper introduces TRACER, a multimodal LLM-agent framework that integrates continuous hospital video and clinical records, evaluating it on newly constructed benchmark datasets and retrospective patient cohorts.
